description: This Java class defines a custom FreeMarker template transform for rendering sub-content within the OFBiz content management system. It implements TemplateTransformModel to facilitate content rendering in FreeMarker templates, handling parameters, environment setup, and content rendering logic.

classes.name: RenderSubContentTransform
classes.description: A FreeMarker transform for rendering sub-content in OFBiz templates. Implements TemplateTransformModel and manages content rendering, parameter handling, and environment setup for sub-content display.

methods.name: getArg
methods.description: Deprecated utility method for retrieving transform arguments with fallback to environment or context; suggests using FreeMarkerWorker.getArg() instead.

methods.name: getWriter
methods.description: Main method that returns a Writer which, upon closing, renders sub-content based on parameters and context, integrating with OFBiz's content system.

methods.name: renderSubContent
methods.description: Inner method within the Writer that performs the actual rendering of sub-content, setting up environment variables and invoking ContentWorker rendering methods.
